goal: Design the WARM blade image (dockers warmed like our ribs): (1) docker/Dockerfile.blade — FROM ollama/ollama, plus git, plus ENTRYPOINT that starts ollama serve and runs docker/warm_preload.sh; (2) docker/warm_preload.sh — pulls EVERY model named in state/vast/blade_templates.json (read the registry, loop `ollama pull`), writes /root/status.json phase rows (pull/ready) same shape boot_watcher.py expects; (3) docs/WARM_BLADE_RUNBOOK.md — the snapshot loop: launch cheap box -> build/pull once -> vast snapshot as private image -> template entries gain "warm_image" field -> next launches boot in minutes not tens of minutes. Mark the snapshot step OPERATOR-GO (it spends).
invariants: bind the EXISTING shapes: status.json phases from bootstrap_box.py/boot_watcher.py expectations, template registry fields from blade_templates.json
preload script reads the registry at runtime — registry changes never require image rebuild
no instance creation, no snapshot execution (files+code+docs only), no covenant edits
acceptance_commands: test -f docker/Dockerfile.blade && test -f docker/warm_preload.sh && test -f docs/WARM_BLADE_RUNBOOK.md && echo FILES OK

.venv/Scripts/python.exe -c "import json; d=json.load(open('state/vast/blade_templates.json')); print('registry models:', sum(len(t.get('models',[])) if 'models' in t else 1 for t in d['templates']))"
resume_command: grok#1: read jobs/blade-warm-image/seat_contract.json + latest trail_core, do next_action, run acceptance, write trail_core_N
opened_by: zcode (operator: dockers designed and warmed like our ribs)
